tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Lists the jobs NL;NL Labs tests every day, what each one asks, what counts as right (the site's own words), the models and systems tested on each job and the dates covered. NL;NL Labs' own models are marked; NL;NL Desk is a system, not a model. Not open yet.

tools.name: get_pick
tools.description: Use it when someone asks which model to use for a job. Returns the job page's latest published pick. tools.name: get_model_history
tools.description: Use to follow one model on one job over time (for example, has it got cheaper or worse). Returns its published days: right answers, items, cost per 1,000 right in US dollars and IPD (right answers per dollar). tools.name: get_day_results
tools.description: Use to compare the models and systems on one job on one day. Leave date out for the newest day. Returns every model's and system's published result that day, NL;NL Labs' own models and systems marked. Extract's documents days also carry invented, missed and unreadable counts. Fields: cost_per_1000_r

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_pick" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
